newsitem.title: JAPAN: Donor group pledges $5.3 billion to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Donor group pledges $5.3 billion to Indonesia.

text.p: A group of donor nations and financial institutions led by the World Bank pledged a total of $5.3 billion to Indonesia this year to support the country's development programme, the World Bank said in a statement on Thursday.
"We are very happy and we have received several good proposals from members," Saleh Afiff, minister for economics, finance and supervisor of development, told a news conference.
In the previous year, the Consultative Group for Indonesia (CGI) also pledged a total of $5.3 billion, a World Bank spokeswoman in Tokyo said.
